title: Learn, Freeze, and Transfer an Activation Function Across Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2611.26201v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transfer learning typically reuses knowledge acquired by a source network through its learned weights. We investigate whether a learned activation function can also be transferred and remain useful in networks trained from scratch. We study this complementary form of transfer through a learn-freeze-transfer protocol, in which the activation is optimized jointly with a source network in a single training run, and is then frozen and reused in target networks trained from scratch. A pointwise activation with globally shared parameters is independent of layer dimensions and can therefore be incorporated into networks of different architectures trained from scratch. We instantiate this protocol with FAct, a five-parameter activation represented by a two-harmonic truncated Fourier series, initialized from a Fourier approximation of GELU and learned in a Vision Transformer (ViT) on ImageNet-1K. translated_title: 学习、冻结并跨架构迁移激活函数
translated_abstract: 迁移学习通常通过复用源网络学到的权重来传递知识。我们研究学习到的激活函数是否也可以被迁移，并在从零开始训练的网络中保持有效。我们通过“学习-冻结-迁移”协议研究这种互补形式的迁移：激活函数与源网络在单次训练中联合优化，随后被冻结并复用于从零开始训练的目标网络。具有全局共享参数的逐点激活函数与层的维度无关，因此可以嵌入到从零开始训练的不同架构的网络中。我们用 FAct 实例化该协议，FAct 是一个由双谐波截断傅里叶级数表示的五参数激活函数，以 GELU 的傅里叶近似初始化，并在 ImageNet-1K 上的视觉 Transformer（ViT）中学习得到。当在相同架构的 ViT 中复用时……
tldr: 该论文提出“学习-冻结-迁移”协议和五参数傅里叶级数激活函数 FAct，证明从源网络学得的激活函数可以被冻结并跨架构迁移到从零训练的网络中，成为权重迁移之外的一种互补性知识迁移方式。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a learn-freeze-transfer protocol and FAct, a five-parameter two-harmonic truncated Fourier activation, demonstrating that a learned activation function can be frozen and transferred across architectures into networks trained from scratch as a complementary form of transfer learning beyond weight reuse.
